INTERFACE PREVIEW
⌖

AIM SYSTEM

Set the standard.
Then make it yours.

Choose your target bone, adjust field of view and distance, and shape the response with smoothing and sway compensation.

  • Normal and silent aim options
  • Head-first selection and upper-body fallback
  • Visibility and team filtering
  • Configurable auto-fire and autowall

Settings shown are illustrative. Interface previews are rendered from the project, rather than live gameplay captures.

High-precision aimbot.

Fresh head-first targeting, configurable bones, FOV and distance. Choose normal or silent aim and keep target selection on your terms.

Fast, direct response.

Choose immediate unsmoothed aim or refine the feel with smoothing and sway compensation. Build a response that fits your playstyle.

Anti-aim, on demand.

Jitter, reverse and spin modes, with a dedicated T pause / resume toggle. Change the state with a single press.

Independent bot aim.

Tap B to toggle bot aim independently from your human-player aim settings. An on-screen indicator keeps the current state clear.

Auto-fire & autowall.

Configure firing and penetration behavior alongside visibility checks and target filters. A considered set of controls, in one place.

Custom binds. Saved setups.

Give each preset a keyboard or mouse bind. Switch with the menu open or closed, with saved bindings ready for your next session.

Streamproof
Mode.

Coming soon · In development

You’re live. Your squad is about to cross an open street. You have a second to figure out who’s waiting on the other side.

We’re building Streamproof Mode for moments like that. A private cue is designed to help you locate other players without a single marker or overlay on screen. Your viewers see a clean gameplay feed. How the cue reaches you is part of the reveal.

Before
you start.

How do I get my key and build?+

Join the Discord and ask the team about your chosen duration. Your key and build are delivered manually through Discord. This page does not process payments or issue licenses.

When does my access period begin?+

Your timed key starts counting on first activation. The available durations are 24 hours, 3 days or 30 days. Ask the team which build and activation requirements apply before purchasing.

Can I switch presets with the menu closed?+

Yes. Preset hotkeys work with the menu open or closed. Activation pauses during text entry, widget interactions and key capture. Release held keys after these interactions before switching again.

What can I use for a custom bind?+

A single keyboard key or one of the five physical mouse buttons. Preset bindings are saved between sessions. Multi-key chords and mouse wheel movements are not supported by the preset binding system. Existing feature shortcuts retain their actions.

Are these screenshots from live gameplay?+

The loader image is the actual rendered v4.1.2 interface. The Gameplay tab uses a user-supplied in-game DMZ screenshot. The Aim and preset images are rendered interface previews from the project. The sculptural, landscape and keyboard images are custom brand artwork. They show the controls and visual design, not measured gameplay performance. Hit rate and behavior depend on settings and the game environment.
